**Stable ID:** `DATA-01.03` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 01 Scope, taxonomy and governance

Define how coverage is measured per modality and category, with bounded, declared denominators instead of claims of completeness.

## Deliverables

- Coverage-ledger schema with denominator definitions
- Per-cell target depth and quality tiers

## Canonical artifact paths

- `planning/coverage-matrix.json`
- `docs/RESEARCH_METHOD.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each denominator names the source inventory and date it was counted from

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Each coverage cell declares its denominator source, counting method and date
- [ ] Unknown or uncounted cells are explicit rather than zero
- [ ] The ledger validates against its schema in CI

## Non-goals

- Asserting near-exhaustive coverage before inventories are counted

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-01.03.T1` Define coverage metrics
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T1.S1` Define breadth, depth and freshness metrics
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T1.S2` Define quality tiers for records
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T1.S3` Define how unknown counts are represented
- [ ] `DATA-01.03.T2` Build the ledger structure
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T2.S1` Create one ledger row per modality and category cell
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T2.S2` Attach owner and evidence-confidence fields
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T2.S3` Record the source of each denominator
- [ ] `DATA-01.03.T3` Validate
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T3.S1` Add schema and validator checks
  - [ ] `DATA-01.03.T3.S2` Add tests for missing denominators
